explanation: The article states the line from the wartime alliance to the organisation: **"the Declaration by United Nations became the basis of the United Nations (UN), which was formalized in the UN Charter, signed by 50 countries on 26 June 1945."** It is the same name and the same signatories: the article notes that Denmark, which had not signed, was nonetheless invited among the allies to the San Francisco conference of 1945, which is where the Charter was drawn.
